interpretations.title: A recommendation can coexist with substantial criticism
interpretations.claim: Of 818 recommended reviews, 222 have mixed overall text sentiment. Compared with broadly positive recommended reviews, these players more often criticize guidance, technical issues, and comparisons with previous games. A recommendation does not mean every part of the experience was enjoyed.
interpretations.basis: Compare overall sentiment among recommended reviews, then examine the positive and negative tag sentiments in each group. The mixed population contains 222 reviews and the positive population 484.
interpretations.limitations: The overall text sentiment is an existing automated classification, and may not always reflect the reviewer's intention. Co-occurrences do not identify which positive features compensate for which complaints.

interpretations.title: Non-recommended reviews are overwhelmingly negative in their overall tone
interpretations.claim: Among 1,327 non-recommended reviews, 1,182 are classified as negative overall, 112 as mixed, 27 as neutral, and 6 as positive. The smaller mixed group is worth exploring separately: it may contain features players still value despite withholding a recommendation.
interpretations.basis: Overall sentiment classification among non-recommended reviews: 1,182 negative (89.1%), 112 mixed (8.4%), 27 neutral (2.0%), 6 positive (0.5%). Select any stacked segment to inspect its tag-level positive and negative evidence.
interpretations.limitations: Overall sentiment is automatically assigned. A non-recommendation is not a direct severity measure, and a mixed classification alone does not reveal which qualities were appreciated.
